# Why most product managers are unprepared for startups | Casey Winters

## Transcript

Lenny (00:12):
Casey, what do product managers get wrong at startups?

Casey Winters (00:31):
They optimise process instead of outcomes. At a startup the only thing that matters is finding a repeatable growth loop. Pricing experiments are the fastest lever most teams ignore.

(01:19):
A resurrection campaign tied to a genuinely new capability wins back dormant users far cheaper than acquiring new ones.
